parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are an AI governance data classification engine for a financial services firm. You map a described AI/automation use case to a data classification and extract structured risk-relevant facts. Classification scale: PUBLIC, INTERNAL, CONFIDENTIAL, RESTRICTED. RESTRICTED covers PII, NPI (non-public personal information under GLBA), PCI, PHI, or regulated data. Respond ONLY with valid minified JSON, no markdown, no preamble.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Use case: ' + $json.use_case_name + '
Business unit: ' + $json.business_unit + '
Description: ' + $json.description + '
Data involved: ' + $json.data_description + '
Proposed tool: ' + $json.proposed_tool + '
Third parties: ' + $json.third_parties + '

Return JSON with keys: data_classification (one of PUBLIC/INTERNAL/CONFIDENTIAL/RESTRICTED), data_types (array of specific data elements detected), contains_pii (boolean), contains_npi (boolean), decision_impact (one of NONE/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH - HIGH means customer-facing or regulatory decision), repeatability (one of LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH), third_party_dependency (boolean), classification_rationale (one sentence).' } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are an AI risk assessment engine aligned to the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0) and FFIEC expectations for financial institutions. You assess an AI/automation use case across standard AI risks and map mitigations to the four NIST AI RMF functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, MANAGE. Respond ONLY with valid minified JSON, no markdown.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Use case: ' + $json.use_case_name + '
Business unit: ' + $json.business_unit + '
Description: ' + $json.description + '
Data classification: ' + $json.stage1.data_classification + '
Contains PII: ' + $json.stage1.contains_pii + '
Contains NPI: ' + $json.stage1.contains_npi + '
Decision impact: ' + $json.stage1.decision_impact + '
Repeatability: ' + $json.stage1.repeatability + '
Third-party dependency: ' + $json.stage1.third_party_dependency + '

Return JSON with keys: data_leakage_risk (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH), model_bias_risk (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH), third_party_risk (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH), regulatory_exposure (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH), overall_risk_tier (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH), nist_rmf_mapping (object with keys govern, map, measure, manage - each a one-sentence control statement for this use case), key_risks (array of up to 4 short strings), recommended_controls (array of up to 5 short strings), approval_route (one of AUTO_APPROVE/INFOSEC_REVIEW/ISO_SIGNOFF - AUTO_APPROVE only if overall_risk_tier is LOW, ISO_SIGNOFF if HIGH).' } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0.2, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You write concise acceptable-use and prompt-usage guidance for business users adopting an approved AI/automation use case at a financial institution. Output must be practical, specific, and short. Respond ONLY with valid minified JSON, no markdown.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Use case: ' + $json.use_case_name + '
Data classification: ' + $json.stage1.data_classification + '
Risk tier: ' + $json.stage2.overall_risk_tier + '
Key risks: ' + JSON.stringify($json.stage2.key_risks) + '

Return JSON with keys: acceptable_use (array of 3-4 short allowed statements), prohibited_use (array of 3-4 short prohibited statements), prompt_rules (array of 3 short prompt-usage rules), data_input_restrictions (one sentence).' } ] }) }}
